name: Single Leg Calf Raise (Bodyweight)
instructions: Stand on one foot holding a wall for balance.
Rise onto the ball of your foot.
Lower slowly until your heel is below your toes if on a step.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A single-leg calf raise using your bodyweight for the calf and ankle stabilisers.
